title: H5b fix round 2: the re-spawn age check reads the task's own events instead of a global bus.events page (which goes blind after 10,000 events), and _requeue clears respawned_at inside clear_stage's single update (review T-0394)
spec:
STEP 0: the worktree must contain ec54196, 3164bed and f7df4d7 (T-0363, T-0393) in git log; never drop or amend them.
Review T-0394 on T-0393, both findings to address:
1. (high) orchestrator/daemon.py:572 the re-spawn check calls bus.events(limit=10000, task_ids=[task id]), a global cursor page (seq greater than 0, limit 10000) filtered afterwards, so once the bus holds more than 10,000 events any newer review or spec_review has zero matching rows, created_at falls back to now, and the unclaimed-task recovery never fires. Use the task record's own events list (task["events"], which bus.get returns and which carries claimed/status/requeue entries with ts) to find the creation time (first event ts, or the task file's first event) and the most recent "process died; requeued" event; never page the global event log for a per-task question. Test: tests/test_daemon.py::test_respawn_age_uses_task_events_not_global_page (seed the bus with more than 10,000 events, then a fresh unclaimed spec_review older than respawn_after_s is still re-spawned).
2. (low) orchestrator/daemon.py:341 _requeue performs two locked update round trips (clear_stage's update, then a second update to pop respawned_at). Fold the respawned_at clear into clear_stage's single pipeline update (one event per requeue). Test: assert in the existing requeue test that one update event is appended, or add test_requeue_appends_one_event.
Keep the T-0363 and T-0393 tests green. Run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh from the worktree root until it exits 0, then git add -A and git commit with the task id; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: git log --oneline in the worktree shows f7df4d7, 3164bed and ec54196 below your commit
tests/test_daemon.py::test_respawn_age_uses_task_events_not_global_page passes and grep shows no bus.events call in the re-spawn path
tests/test_daemon.py::test_requeue_appends_one_event passes (or the existing requeue test asserts a single update event)
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
